title: Future of AI Arcade
intro: Look ahead and level up! Test your knowledge of AI careers and the future. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐.

rounds.prompt: Match each AI career to what they do.
rounds.explain: Each AI career focuses on a different part of building and using intelligent systems.

rounds.prompt: Which field can AI help improve?
rounds.explain: AI is transforming many fields, from medicine and farming to space and education.

rounds.prompt: What's a good first step to design an AI solution?
options: Pick a real problem and think about the data needed
Wait for someone else to do it
rounds.explain: Great AI projects start with a real problem and the right data to learn from.

rounds.prompt: Match each project to its level.
rounds.explain: Projects range from beginner quiz bots to advanced study assistants.

rounds.prompt: What will AI do to many industries?
options: Create new opportunities and transform them
rounds.explain: AI will create new opportunities and transform many industries, and you can help build that future.
